text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
T-Today... I won't just be following from 
behind anymore, you know~.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Admiring Opera O-san, helped by 
Trainer-san, I finally...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hear me, everyone! Allow me to introduce 
him. Standing beside me as my First Knight 
in this Takarazuka Kinen is—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"This is the Umamusume! Step forward, 
Meisho Doto!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: H-Hahaha, yeees~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite the nerves, taking steady steps 
forward, one by one...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though trembling, Meisho Doto stood beside 
TM Opera O.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
(I'll support Opera O and run alongside 
her. From here on, forever and ever...)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
(If I can do that, I'm sure I can become a 
sparkling Umamusume just like Opera 
O-san!)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
(If I can become a sparkling version of 
myself... even against the Golden 
Generation, those Umamusume a year above 
me...)

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Doto, you've done well to make it this 
far.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I've been waiting. For half a year— ever 
since that day last autumn, all this time.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh? Last autumn...? Does that mean...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, don't you remember? That day 
Ayabe-san stepped away.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Take care, Ayabe-san. Come now, I'm sure 
you'll be fine. And yet...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The battle against the previous 
generation... the Golden Generation, just 
got a whole lot tougher.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"If either of the two titans is missing, 
I'll be thoroughly marked and boxed in."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Still, this too is fate. Now that it's 
come to this, I suppose all we can do is 
wait."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek, then what about when you said all 
we could do was wait...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
What I have been waiting for—is an 
awakening. Even if her strides are slow, 
of a heroine who will without a doubt 
awaken one day.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Opera O-san... Opera O...-san...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Yes, please watch my running!
